div.div: Design principle: no single control is load-bearing. The ACL can be misconfigured, a credential can be stolen, the IDS can miss a slow ramp; each failure is caught by another layer, and the residual risk is written down in the STRIDE table.

text.tspan: Design principle: no single control is load-bearing. The ACL can be misconfigured, a credential can be stolen, the IDS can miss a slow ramp;
each failure is caught by another layer, and the residual risk is written down in the STRIDE table.
